nodes.Name: Size
nodes.DocComment: The size of a SHA-1 checksum in bytes.

nodes.Name: BlockSize
nodes.DocComment: The blocksize of SHA-1 in bytes.

nodes.Name: digest
nodes.DocComment: digest represents the partial evaluation of a checksum.

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment:
New returns a new [hash.Hash] computing the SHA1 checksum. The Hash
also implements [encoding.BinaryMarshaler], [encoding.BinaryAppender] and
[encoding.BinaryUnmarshaler] to marshal and unmarshal the internal
state of the hash.

nodes.Name: ConstantTimeSum
nodes.DocComment: ConstantTimeSum computes the same result of [Sum] but in constant time

nodes.Name: Sum
nodes.DocComment: Sum returns the SHA-1 checksum of the data.
